description: This file contains handler functions for managing auto-compaction events within an agent context, including starting, ending, and reconciling compaction counts, as well as auxiliary functions for session message management.

methods.name: handleAutoCompactionStart
methods.description: Initiates auto-compaction process, triggers pre-compaction hooks, and logs the start event.

methods.name: handleAutoCompactionEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of auto-compaction, updates counters, triggers post-compaction hooks, and manages retries.

methods.name: reconcileSessionStoreCompactionCountAfterSuccess
methods.description: Reconciles the session store compaction count after a successful compaction, dynamically imported.

methods.name: clearStaleAssistantUsageOnSessionMessages
methods.description: Resets stale assistant usage data in session messages to zero snapshots.
